INGREDIENTS.EDITOR_DESCRIPTION: Data, allergens, substitutes, prices and recipe impact
INGREDIENTS.STALE_HINT: Price older than 60 days: update it so you never sell below cost.
INGREDIENTS.DELETE_BLOCKED: Used in {{ count }} recipes; replace it before deleting.
INGREDIENTS.REFERENCE_HINT: The market reference price is being used. Register your purchase price to cost with your real data.
INGREDIENTS.SYSTEM_READONLY: Cronos catalog ingredient: you can register your price, but its data is maintained by the platform.
INGREDIENTS.READONLY: You are not allowed to edit this ingredient.
INGREDIENTS.MEASURE_HINT: Define how it is measured and how much is usable; an exact cost depends on it.
INGREDIENTS.DIMENSION_LOCKED: Locked because recipes already use it.
INGREDIENTS.YIELD_HINT: Usable percentage after cleaning, peeling or sifting. 100 % = no waste.
INGREDIENTS.DENSITY_HINT: Grams per millilitre; lets you use cups/ml for ingredients bought by weight (and vice versa). Water = 1.
INGREDIENTS.FIRST_PRICE_HINT: If you enter it now, the ingredient can be costed right away.
INGREDIENTS.PRICE_INCOMPLETE: Complete presentation, unit and price, or leave the price empty.
INGREDIENTS.ALLERGENS_HINT: Declare what it contains. We suggest allergens based on the name.
INGREDIENTS.SUBSTITUTES_HINT: Alternatives to replace it in recipes (e.g. allergen-free versions), with their ratio.
INGREDIENTS.HISTORY_HINT: Every registered price stays in the history with who entered it and when.

RECIPES.TITLE: Recipes
RECIPES.DESCRIPTION: Recipe book with live costs, allergens and documented processes
RECIPES.EMPTY: You have no recipes yet. Create the first one.

ADD.HINT: Shortcut: search, type the quantity and press Enter.

RECIPES.NO_LINES: Add the first ingredient with the bar above.
RECIPES.LINE_COST_HINT: Cost of this line at the base yield, including the ingredient's waste.
RECIPES.LINE_UNPRICED: Unpriced ingredient: the recipe cost is understated.
RECIPES.UNPRICED_ADDED: {{ ingredient }} has no price; register it to cost correctly.
RECIPES.QUOTE_SELECTABLE_HINT: When quoting you can include or remove it (e.g. frosting, filling, decoration).
RECIPES.NO_SUBSTITUTES: This ingredient has no registered substitutes. Add them on its page.
RECIPES.EXTRA_ALLERGENS_HINT: Use it for cross-contamination or specific presentations of this ingredient.

ERRORS.DUPLICATE: This ingredient is already in the same section.
ERRORS.NO_LINES: The recipe needs at least one ingredient.
ERRORS.LINES_INVALID: {{ count }} lines to fix in Ingredients.
ERRORS.MAX_LINES: At most {{ max }} ingredients per recipe.

STUDIO.DESCRIPTION: Ingredients, process, costing, files and history of the recipe
STUDIO.NEW_HINT: Complete the recipe; you can save it as a draft
STUDIO.DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: Commercial description that can appear on the quote
STUDIO.PROCESS_HINT: Document step by step: techniques, times, temperatures and critical points. Supports lists, bold, headings and links.
STUDIO.MARGINS_HINT: The target margin sets the suggested price; waste covers what is lost in the process (pans, trimmings, tests).
STUDIO.TARGET_MARGIN_HINT: Quotes warn when the price falls below it.
STUDIO.WASTE_HINT: Extra percentage on top of the ingredients cost.
STUDIO.FIXED_COSTS_HINT: Labour, gas, packaging or rent prorated to this recipe.
STUDIO.NO_FIXED_COST_CATALOG: You have no fixed costs yet:
STUDIO.MINUTES_REQUIRED: Enter the minutes for the hourly cost.
STUDIO.SAVE_FIRST: Save your changes before changing the status.
STUDIO.PUBLISH_MESSAGE: It will become available for quotes.
STUDIO.PUBLISH_UNPRICED: Warning: {{ count }} ingredients have no price and the cost is understated.
STUDIO.DELETE_MESSAGE: “{{ name }}” will be deleted. Existing quotes keep their information.
STUDIO.LEAVE_UPLOADING: Files are uploading or queued. If you leave, they will be cancelled.
